keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-project: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-project-scope","level":"B2","sentences":[{"meaning":"客戶想增加兩項功能，但不想延後截止日期。","speaker":"A","text":"The client wants two extra features without moving the deadline."},{"meaning":"我們應該先釐清現有工作中哪些可以延後，再答應。","speaker":"B","text":"We should clarify which existing tasks can be postponed before agreeing."},{"meaning":"他們認為每一項都不可少，但我們只有三位開發人員能投入。","speaker":"A","text":"They consider everything essential, although we only have three developers available."},{"meaning":"那就用調整後的時程，讓他們看清楚需要做哪些取捨。","speaker":"B","text":"Then let's show them the trade-offs using a revised schedule."},{"meaning":"我們能先交付核心功能，之後再推出其餘部分嗎？","speaker":"A","text":"Could we deliver the core features first and release the rest later?"},{"meaning":"那應該可行，前提是他們接受範疇明確的第二階段。","speaker":"B","text":"That seems feasible, provided they accept a clearly defined second phase."}],"source":"manual","title":"專案需求增加時的取捨"}

keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-assessm: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-assessment-design","level":"B2","sentences":[{"meaning":"筆試能公平反映學生實際具備的能力嗎？","speaker":"A","text":"Do written exams give us a fair picture of what students can actually do?"},{"meaning":"筆試能有效評量某些知識，但實務技能可能需要不同方式。","speaker":"B","text":"They measure some knowledge well, but practical skills may require a different approach."},{"meaning":"我在考慮用小組專案取代期末考。","speaker":"A","text":"I was thinking of replacing the final exam with a group project."},{"meaning":"那可以鼓勵合作，不過個人貢獻可能不容易評量。","speaker":"B","text":"That could encourage collaboration, although individual contributions might be difficult to assess."},{"meaning":"如果學生也要繳交簡短的反思，說明自己做的決定呢？","speaker":"A","text":"What if students also submitted a short reflection explaining their decisions?"},{"meaning":"那會有幫助，前提是一開始就清楚說明評量標準。","speaker":"B","text":"That would help, as long as the assessment criteria are clear from the start."}],"source":"manual","title":"討論課程評量方式"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-bus-ser: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-bus-service","level":"B2","sentences":[{"meaning":"地方議會想透過降低公車票價吸引更多乘客。","speaker":"A","text":"The council wants to attract more passengers by reducing bus fares."},{"meaning":"降價會有幫助，但在我住的地方，班次不可靠是更大的問題。","speaker":"B","text":"Lower fares would help, but unreliable services are a bigger problem in my area."},{"meaning":"增加尖峰時段班次會有改善嗎？","speaker":"A","text":"Would increasing the frequency during rush hour make a difference?"},{"meaning":"會，尤其是對上班途中需要轉車的人。","speaker":"B","text":"Yes, particularly for people who need to change buses on their way to work."},{"meaning":"也許預算應該分配在票價補助和服務改善兩方面。","speaker":"A","text":"Perhaps the budget should be split between cheaper tickets and service improvements."},{"meaning":"如果議會公布明確的可靠度目標，我會支持。","speaker":"B","text":"I'd support that if the council published clear targets for reliability."}],"source":"manual","title":"改善郊區公車服務"}

keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-news-he: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-news-headline","level":"B2","sentences":[{"meaning":"這個標題聲稱，在家工作會讓人生產力下降。","speaker":"A","text":"This headline claims that working from home makes people less productive."},{"meaning":"文章有提供證據，還是主要在轉述某人的意見？","speaker":"B","text":"Does the article provide evidence, or is it mainly reporting someone's opinion?"},{"meaning":"它提到一份問卷調查，但我找不到受訪者的詳細資料。","speaker":"A","text":"It refers to a survey, but I can't find any details about who took part."},{"meaning":"缺少這些背景，就很難判斷結果有多少代表性。","speaker":"B","text":"Without that context, it's difficult to judge how representative the results are."},{"meaning":"我會先找原始報告，再分享這篇報導。","speaker":"A","text":"I'll look for the original report before sharing the story."},{"meaning":"這樣很合理，因為標題的語氣可能超過研究發現能支持的程度。","speaker":"B","text":"That's sensible, because the headline may be stronger than the findings justify."}],"source":"manual","title":"新聞標題是否誤導"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-office-: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-office-emissions","level":"B2","sentences":[{"meaning":"公司承諾減少排放，但計畫裡大多只提到回收。","speaker":"A","text":"Our company has promised to reduce emissions, but the plan mostly mentions recycling."},{"meaning":"回收很重要，但能源使用和商務差旅的影響可能更大。","speaker":"B","text":"Recycling matters, though energy use and business travel may have a larger impact."},{"meaning":"我們能用線上會議取代部分搭機出差嗎？","speaker":"A","text":"Could we replace some flights with online meetings?"},{"meaning":"應該可以，前提是團隊能說明什麼時候需要當面見面。","speaker":"B","text":"Probably, provided teams can explain when meeting in person is necessary."},{"meaning":"我們應該先測量目前的排放量，再訂出務實的目標。","speaker":"A","text":"We should measure our current emissions before setting realistic targets."},{"meaning":"同意。否則我們不會知道這些改變有沒有成效。","speaker":"B","text":"Agreed. Otherwise, we won't know whether the changes are making a difference."}],"source":"manual","title":"降低辦公室的碳排放"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-deliver: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-delivery-negotiation","level":"B2","sentences":[{"meaning":"如果交貨日期延後兩週，我們就能配合您要求的價格。","speaker":"A","text":"We can meet your requested price if the delivery date is extended by two weeks."},{"meaning":"那會影響我們如期推出產品。你們能先交付部分訂單嗎？","speaker":"B","text":"That would put our launch at risk. keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-survey-: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-survey-results","level":"B2","sentences":[{"meaning":"我們的調查顯示，規律運動的學生也回報較好的睡眠。","speaker":"A","text":"Our survey suggests that students who exercise regularly also report better sleep."},{"meaning":"我們能推論是運動造成改善嗎？","speaker":"B","text":"Can we conclude that exercise caused the improvement?"},{"meaning":"單靠這些結果還不行，因為我們沒有控制其他習慣的影響。","speaker":"A","text":"Not from these results alone, since we didn't control for other habits."},{"meaning":"例如，那些學生晚上使用手機的時間也可能比較少。","speaker":"B","text":"For example, those students might also spend less time on their phones at night."},{"meaning":"沒錯。我們應該描述其中的關聯，不宣稱有因果關係。","speaker":"A","text":"Exactly. We should describe the relationship without claiming cause and effect."},{"meaning":"我們在摘要和完整報告中，都要清楚說明這個限制。","speaker":"B","text":"Let's make that limitation clear in the summary as well as the full report."}],"source":"manual","title":"解讀問卷結果的限制"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-career-: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-career-change","level":"B2","sentences":[{"meaning":"我在考慮從業務轉做培訓，但我沒有正式資格。","speaker":"A","text":"I'm considering a move from sales into training, but I don't have a formal qualification."},{"meaning":"你已經培養了可轉用的技能，尤其是解說產品和處理提問。","speaker":"B","text":"You've already developed transferable skills, especially explaining products and handling questions."},{"meaning":"聽你這麼說很受鼓勵，不過設計完整課程對我來說是新的挑戰。","speaker":"A","text":"That's encouraging, though designing an entire course would be new to me."},{"meaning":"在投入長期課程之前，你能先跟著有經驗的培訓師觀摩嗎？","speaker":"B","text":"Could you shadow an experienced trainer before committing to a longer course?"},{"meaning":"我可以問培訓經理，有沒有我能協助的專案。","speaker":"A","text":"I could ask our training manager whether there's a project I can assist with."},{"meaning":"這樣既能確認自己的興趣，也能累積相關經驗。","speaker":"B","text":"That would let you test your interest while building relevant experience."}],"source":"manual","title":"評估轉換職涯方向"}

keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-cross-c: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-cross-cultural-meeting","level":"B2","sentences":[{"meaning":"有幾位同事開會時沒有說話，所以我不確定他們是否支持提案。","speaker":"A","text":"Some colleagues stayed quiet during the meeting, so I'm not sure they supported the proposal."},{"meaning":"沉默不一定代表同意或反對；他們可能需要更多時間回應。","speaker":"B","text":"Silence doesn't necessarily mean agreement or disagreement; they may need more time to respond."},{"meaning":"我可能徵詢意見後，太快就進入下一項了。","speaker":"A","text":"I might have moved on too quickly after asking for comments."},{"meaning":"你可以邀請大家提供書面回饋，並說明歡迎不同觀點。","speaker":"B","text":"You could invite written feedback and explain that different views are welcome."},{"meaning":"那也能幫助不容易跟上快速討論的人。","speaker":"A","text":"That would also help anyone who finds fast discussions difficult to follow."},{"meaning":"沒錯。我們避免根據個人背景，對他們做想當然的推測。","speaker":"B","text":"Exactly. Let's avoid making assumptions about individuals based on their background."}],"source":"manual","title":"跨文化會議裡的沉默"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-outdoor: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-b2-outdoor-event","level":"B2","sentences":[{"meaning":"天氣預報顯示，戶外工作坊當天可能會下大雨。","speaker":"A","text":"The forecast suggests heavy rain on the day of our outdoor workshop."},{"meaning":"我們有能容納所有人的替代場地嗎？","speaker":"B","text":"Do we have an alternative venue with enough capacity for everyone?"},{"meaning":"社區活動中心可以使用，但我們得重新安排設備。","speaker":"A","text":"The community hall is available, but we'd need to rearrange the equipment."},{"meaning":"預訂前，先檢查入口、廁所和座位是否符合無障礙需求。","speaker":"B","text":"Before booking it, let's check the entrance, toilets, and seating for accessibility."},{"meaning":"我今天會確認，地點確定後就通知志工。","speaker":"A","text":"I'll do that today and update the volunteers once the location is confirmed."},{"meaning":"也請通知參加者，包括報名時沒有留電子郵件地址的人。","speaker":"B","text":"Please notify participants as well, including anyone who registered without an email address."}],"source":"manual","title":"戶外活動的雨天備案"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-strateg: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-strategic-pilot","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"試辦銷售超過目標，但我不太願意把這點視為全國推出的充分依據。","speaker":"A","text":"The pilot exceeded its sales target, but I'm reluctant to treat that as sufficient evidence for a nationwide launch."},{"meaning":"你的保留在於樣本大小，還是其他地方能否重現相同條件？","speaker":"B","text":"Is your reservation about the size of the sample, or about whether the conditions can be reproduced elsewhere?"},{"meaning":"兩者都有，尤其當地團隊獲得的支援，我們實際上無法提供給每個分店。","speaker":"A","text":"Both, particularly since the local team received support that we couldn't realistically provide to every branch."},{"meaning":"那麼，在一般人力配置下再試辦一次，可能比單純延長目前試辦更有參考價值。","speaker":"B","text":"Then a second pilot under ordinary staffing conditions might tell us more than simply extending the current one."},{"meaning":"同意，前提是先界定什麼結果足以支持擴張，以及什麼結果會促使我們調整方向。","speaker":"A","text":"Agreed, provided we define in advance which results would justify expansion and which would trigger a course correction."},{"meaning":"我會修改提案，讓決策依據那些標準，而非專案既有的推進聲勢。","speaker":"B","text":"I'll revise the proposal so the decision depends on those criteria rather than the momentum behind the project."}],"source":"manual","title":"試辦成果足以支持擴張嗎"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-automat: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-automated-decisions","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"系統或許能更一致地處理申請，但一致性本身不足以證明決策公平。","speaker":"A","text":"The system may process applications more consistently, yet consistency alone doesn't establish that its decisions are fair."},{"meaning":"尤其是當歷史資料反映的弱勢處境，本來就不是申請人能左右的。","speaker":"B","text":"That's especially true if the historical data reflects disadvantages that applicants have had little control over in the first place."},{"meaning":"我們需要真正有用的申訴程序，不能只有一份告知已進行自動評估的通知。","speaker":"A","text":"We need a meaningful appeal process, not merely a notice stating that an automated assessment has taken place."},{"meaning":"那需要具備權限和專業的人來質疑結果，而不是照例核可。","speaker":"B","text":"That would require someone with the authority and expertise to question the outcome, rather than routinely approving it."},{"meaning":"我們也能在不揭露其他申請人個資的前提下，說明決策背後的主要因素嗎？","speaker":"A","text":"Could we also explain the main factors behind a decision without disclosing personal information about other applicants?"},{"meaning":"我們應該研究這個做法，同時清楚表明：提供解釋並不免除我們更正錯誤的責任。","speaker":"B","text":"We should explore that, while making it clear that an explanation does not remove our responsibility to correct errors."}],"source":"manual","title":"自動決策與申訴權利"}

{"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-automated-decisions","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"系統或許能更一致地處理申請，但一致性本身不足以證明決策公平。","speaker":"A","text":"The system may process applications more consistently, yet consistency alone doesn't establish that its decisions are fair."},{"meaning":"尤其是當歷史資料反映的弱勢處境，本來就不是申請人能左右的。","speaker":"B","text":"Especially if the historical data reflects disadvantages that applicants have had little control over in the first place."},{"meaning":"我們需要真正有用的申訴程序，不能只有一份告知已進行自動評估的通知。","speaker":"A","text":"We need a meaningful appeal process, not merely a notice stating that an automated assessment has taken place."},{"meaning":"那需要具備權限和專業的人來質疑結果，而不是照例核可。","speaker":"B","text":"That would require someone with the authority and expertise to question the outcome, rather than routinely approving it."},{"meaning":"我們也能在不揭露其他申請人個資的前提下，說明決策背後的主要因素嗎？","speaker":"A","text":"Could we also explain the main factors behind a decision without disclosing personal information about other applicants?"},{"meaning":"我們應該研究這個做法，同時清楚表明：提供解釋並不免除我們更正錯誤的責任。","speaker":"B","text":"We should explore that, while making it clear that an explanation does not remove our responsibility to correct errors."}],"source":"manual","title":"自動決策與申訴權利"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-researc: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-research-caveats","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"這項效果在幾種模型中都顯得穩健，不過研究仍依賴參與者自行回報行為。","speaker":"A","text":"The effect appears robust across several models, although the study still relies on participants reporting their own behaviour."},{"meaning":"這仍可能產生回報偏差，尤其當參與者猜到了研究者希望收到什麼回答時。","speaker":"B","text":"That leaves room for reporting bias, particularly if participants guessed which responses the researchers were hoping to receive."},{"meaning":"把發現描述為暫定，會低估我們觀察到的一致性，還是恰當反映方法上的限制？","speaker":"A","text":"Would describing the findings as tentative understate the consistency we've observed, or appropriately reflect the limits of the method?"},{"meaning":"我會區分對觀察到的關聯有多大把握，以及對提出的解釋有多大把握，因為那是不同的主張。","speaker":"B","text":"I'd distinguish confidence in the observed association from confidence in the proposed explanation, since those are different claims."},{"meaning":"這個區別應該出現在摘要裡，否則讀者可能轉述結論，卻漏掉附帶限制。","speaker":"A","text":"That distinction should appear in the abstract; otherwise, readers may repeat the conclusion without carrying the caveat along."},{"meaning":"我們也說明還需要哪些證據來強化解釋，讓不確定之處成為後續探究的方向。","speaker":"B","text":"Let's also specify what additional evidence would strengthen the explanation, so the uncertainty points towards further inquiry."}],"source":"manual","title":"研究發現該如何保留語氣"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-team-re: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-team-restructuring","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"這項重整提案減少了一層管理，卻也拆散了目前會非正式協力解決問題的人。","speaker":"A","text":"The proposed restructuring removes a layer of management, but it also separates people who currently resolve problems informally."},{"meaning":"那些關係很少出現在組織圖上，卻支撐了大量日常協調工作。","speaker":"B","text":"Those relationships rarely appear on an organisation chart, even though they underpin a great deal of day-to-day coordination."},{"meaning":"我們要如何保留組織累積的知識，又不把它當成抗拒所有結構調整的理由？","speaker":"A","text":"How do we preserve that institutional knowledge without using it as a reason to resist every structural change?"},{"meaning":"我們可以梳理人們實際做的決策，找出新安排下哪些責任會變得模糊。","speaker":"B","text":"We could map the decisions people actually make and identify where responsibility would become ambiguous under the new arrangement."},{"meaning":"那也能讓員工具體提出疑慮，而不是只問他們原則上支不支持改變。","speaker":"A","text":"That would also give staff a concrete way to raise concerns, rather than asking whether they support change in principle."},{"meaning":"如果那些疑慮帶來看得見的修訂，徵詢意見就更可能建立信任，而非侵蝕信任。","speaker":"B","text":"And if those concerns lead to visible revisions, the consultation is more likely to build trust instead of eroding it."}],"source":"manual","title":"重整團隊時保留組織知識"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-targete: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-targeted-support","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"普遍補助容易執行，但很大一部分會流向並不需要補助的家戶。","speaker":"A","text":"A universal subsidy would be straightforward to administer, but a substantial share would go to households that don't need it."},{"meaning":"針對性的支援可以改善這點，但複雜的資格規定可能排除我們最想幫助的人。","speaker":"B","text":"Targeted support could address that, although complicated eligibility rules may exclude precisely the people we're trying to reach."},{"meaning":"所以行政簡便也有公平性的面向，不只是減輕機關工作量的問題。","speaker":"A","text":"So administrative simplicity has an equity dimension too; it isn't merely a question of reducing the agency's workload."},{"meaning":"沒錯，我們也應該檢視證明資格的負擔由誰承受，尤其對生活狀況經常變動的人。","speaker":"B","text":"Exactly, and we should examine who bears the burden of proving eligibility, particularly when their circumstances change frequently."},{"meaning":"能否先廣泛發放，再透過既有程序調整，而不另外設立申請系統？","speaker":"A","text":"Could an initial broad payment be followed by adjustments through an existing process, rather than a separate application system?"},{"meaning":"有可能，但在把它說成更公平的選項之前，我們需要比較它對領取者的實際影響。","speaker":"B","text":"Possibly, but we'd need to compare the practical consequences for recipients before presenting that as the fairer option."}],"source":"manual","title":"普遍補助與精準支援的兩難"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-respect: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-respectful-objection","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"我理解這個提案為何獲得支持，但我不同意把參與視為認同的假設。","speaker":"A","text":"I can see why the proposal has attracted support, but I take issue with the assumption that participation implies endorsement."},{"meaning":"這個區分合理，不過我也不會認為出席人數與公眾關注程度毫無關係。","speaker":"B","text":"That's a fair distinction, though I wouldn't dismiss the attendance figures as irrelevant to the level of public interest."},{"meaning":"我也不會；我擔心的是，我們正用關注程度的證據來支持更強的同意主張。","speaker":"A","text":"Nor would I; my concern is that we're using evidence of interest to substantiate a stronger claim about consent."},{"meaning":"如果我們限定結論的語氣，也承認現場表達了多種觀點，你能接受保留那些數字嗎？","speaker":"B","text":"Would you be comfortable retaining the figures if we qualified the conclusion and acknowledged the range of views expressed?"},{"meaning":"可以，前提是把分歧呈現在正文，而不是放到很少人注意的註腳裡。","speaker":"A","text":"Yes, provided the disagreement is represented in the main text rather than relegated to a footnote few readers will notice."},{"meaning":"那我們把這一段改成呈現諮詢所揭示的內容，而非把諮詢當成替偏好的方案背書。","speaker":"B","text":"Then let's reframe the section around what the consultation revealed, instead of treating it as confirmation of our preferred option."}],"source":"manual","title":"對共識提出有分寸的異議"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-supplie: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-supplier-resilience","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"依賴單一供應商壓低了成本，卻讓我們暴露在無法控制的中斷風險之下。","speaker":"A","text":"Relying on a single supplier has kept costs down, but it leaves us exposed to disruptions beyond our control."},{"meaning":"分散供應來源能提供緩衝，但維持多方關係可能增加複雜度，並削弱議價能力。","speaker":"B","text":"Diversifying would provide a buffer, although maintaining several relationships could introduce complexity and weaken our negotiating position."},{"meaning":"問題是，計入長時間中斷的成本後，表面上的節省是否仍然成立。","speaker":"A","text":"The question is whether the apparent savings still hold once we account for the cost of a prolonged interruption."},{"meaning":"我們應該測試幾種中斷情境，而不是替缺乏預測依據的事件指定精確機率。","speaker":"B","text":"We should test several disruption scenarios, rather than assigning a precise probability to an event we have little basis to predict."},{"meaning":"那可能顯示哪些零組件確實需要替代來源，以及哪些只要少量安全庫存就能保障供應。","speaker":"A","text":"That might reveal which components genuinely require alternative sources and which can be protected with a modest stock buffer."},{"meaning":"同意；韌性應該依故障後果來設計，而不是一律增加支出。","speaker":"B","text":"Agreed; resilience should be designed around the consequences of failure, not pursued as a blanket increase in spending."}],"source":"manual","title":"供應鏈分散的代價"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-academi: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-academic-premise","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"你的論證很連貫，但核心前提似乎超出了所蒐集證據能合理支持的範疇。","speaker":"A","text":"Your argument is coherent, but its central premise seems broader than the evidence you've assembled can reasonably support."},{"meaning":"你的意思是，我應該把主張限於研究中的社區，而不是推廣到所有城市居民嗎？","speaker":"B","text":"Are you suggesting I narrow the claim to the communities in the study, rather than generalising to all urban residents?"},{"meaning":"那會有幫助，我也會區分受訪者在訪談中表達的偏好，以及在真實限制下觀察到的行為。","speaker":"A","text":"That would help, and I'd also distinguish a preference expressed in interviews from behaviour observed under real constraints."},{"meaning":"如果明確做出這兩個區分，結論會更保守，但也可能更站得住腳。","speaker":"B","text":"If I make both distinctions explicit, the conclusion becomes more modest, though perhaps it also becomes more defensible."},{"meaning":"正是如此；界線清楚的主張，可能比一個反例就能推翻的宏大論點更有貢獻。","speaker":"A","text":"Precisely; a carefully bounded claim can contribute more than an ambitious one that collapses when a counterexample is introduced."},{"meaning":"我會一起修改開頭和結論，避免讀者先接受前提，後面才看到適用限制。","speaker":"B","text":"I'll revise the opening and conclusion together, so the qualifications don't appear only after the reader has accepted the premise."}],"source":"manual","title":"論文前提與結論的距離"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-delegat: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-delegating-authority","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"我告訴團隊，他們可以自行決定，但他們還是一直把小選擇交回來讓我核准。","speaker":"A","text":"I told the team they could make the decision, yet they keep bringing minor choices back to me for approval."},{"meaning":"以前是否曾有人在你設定的界線內行事，決定卻在事後被推翻？","speaker":"B","text":"Have past decisions been overturned after the fact, even when people acted within the boundaries you originally set?"},{"meaning":"偶爾有，而我能理解，這可能讓他們認為主動承擔責任會帶來難以預料的風險。","speaker":"A","text":"Occasionally, and I can see how that might have taught them that taking ownership carries an unpredictable risk."},{"meaning":"授權需要對自主裁量有共同理解，包括哪些不完美的結果，你願意接受而不介入。","speaker":"B","text":"Delegation needs a shared understanding of discretion, including which imperfect outcomes you're prepared to accept without stepping in."},{"meaning":"那我應該更清楚說明界線，也克制自己，不因為我會做不同選擇就重新檢討決定。","speaker":"A","text":"Then I should explain the limits more clearly and resist reopening decisions simply because I would have chosen differently."},{"meaning":"這種一致性，可能比反覆保證你信任他們的判斷，更能建立他們的信心。","speaker":"B","text":"That consistency will probably do more for their confidence than repeatedly assuring them that you trust their judgement."}],"source":"manual","title":"授權為何沒有真正發生"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-urban-r: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-urban-regeneration","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"這個街區更新案可能改善公共空間，但租金可能上漲，已經讓長期居民感到焦慮。","speaker":"A","text":"The regeneration scheme could improve public spaces, but the prospect of rising rents is already making long-term residents anxious."},{"meaning":"如果維繫社區的人最後住不起，很難說這個地方變得更宜居了。","speaker":"B","text":"It's difficult to call the area more liveable if the people who sustained its community can no longer afford to remain."},{"meaning":"規劃者提議保留幾棟歷史建築，但那不一定能保護周圍既有的社會關係。","speaker":"A","text":"The planners have proposed preserving several historic buildings, although that doesn't necessarily protect the social fabric around them."},{"meaning":"能否讓居民一起用租住穩定、服務可近性、在地商家機會等指標來界定成功？","speaker":"B","text":"Could residents help define success through measures such as stable tenancies, accessible services, and opportunities for local businesses?"},{"meaning":"那能讓討論超越房產價值，前提是居民參與對最後決策有實際影響。","speaker":"A","text":"That would broaden the discussion beyond property values, provided their participation has some influence over the eventual decisions."},{"meaning":"那諮詢程序就需要確立居民在哪些部分有發言權，而不只是邀請他們對完成的設計表示意見。","speaker":"B","text":"Then the consultation process needs to establish where residents have a say, rather than merely inviting them to react to finished designs."}],"source":"manual","title":"街區更新與原居民"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-explain: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-explaining-uncertainty","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"技術摘要很準確，但讀者可能難以區分已知事實與仍有解讀空間的部分。","speaker":"A","text":"The technical summary is accurate, yet readers may struggle to distinguish what we know from what remains open to interpretation."},{"meaning":"我們可以先說明實際意涵，再解釋哪些假設會使這個解讀更有或更缺乏說服力。","speaker":"B","text":"We could lead with the practical implication, then explain the assumptions that would make that interpretation more or less persuasive."},{"meaning":"我擔心過度簡化會讓不確定性消失，尤其標題常會脫離詳細說明而被轉傳。","speaker":"A","text":"I'm wary of simplifying it so far that the uncertainty disappears, particularly when the headline will travel without the supporting detail."},{"meaning":"清楚不代表必須確定；我們可以直接陳述主要發現，並在同一句附上具體限制。","speaker":"B","text":"Clarity doesn't require certainty; we can state the main finding plainly and attach a specific limitation to the same sentence."},{"meaning":"若日常用語能保留意思，我們也把專業術語換掉，不要假設技術語言就一定精確。","speaker":"A","text":"Let's also replace specialist jargon where a familiar phrase would preserve the meaning, rather than assuming technical language guarantees precision."},{"meaning":"我會請一位領域外的讀者向我們轉述訊息，這應該能找出剩下的模糊之處。","speaker":"B","text":"I'll ask a reader outside the field to explain the message back to us, which should reveal any remaining ambiguity."}],"source":"manual","title":"向公眾說明不確定性"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-green-c: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-green-claims","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"包裝宣稱產品環保，但這個說法似乎完全建立在運送重量降低這一點上。","speaker":"A","text":"The packaging calls the product environmentally friendly, but the claim seems to rest entirely on a reduction in shipping weight."},{"meaning":"那可能是有意義的改善，但不足以證明整個生命週期的環境衝擊都比較低。","speaker":"B","text":"That could be a meaningful improvement, though it doesn't establish that the overall environmental impact is lower across the life cycle."},{"meaning":"我們需要生產、使用和廢棄處理的可比較資訊，並明確說明評估界線。","speaker":"A","text":"We'd need comparable information about production, use, and disposal, with the boundaries of the assessment made explicit."},{"meaning":"而且比較應採用相關的基準，不能挑一個特別有利於自家產品的替代品。","speaker":"B","text":"And any comparison should use a relevant benchmark, rather than a selectively chosen alternative that makes the product look favourable."},{"meaning":"在更廣泛的宣稱能獲得獨立驗證之前，只陳述包裝重量的減少是否比較站得住腳？","speaker":"A","text":"Would a narrower statement about packaging weight be more defensible until the broader claim can be independently verified?"},{"meaning":"是的；說清楚改善內容及限制，既能提供有用資訊，也不會引導顧客推論出超過證據支持的結論。","speaker":"B","text":"Yes; specifying the improvement and its limits would give customers useful information without inviting them to infer more than the evidence supports."}],"source":"manual","title":"產品永續標示的證據"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-cross-b: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-cross-border-partnership","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"合作雙方認同商業目標，卻用相同術語描述在不同司法管轄地有所差異的義務。","speaker":"A","text":"The partners agree on the commercial objective, but they're using the same terms to describe obligations that differ between jurisdictions."},{"meaning":"我們應該先請相關專業人員找出差異，再把草案視為對責任的共同理解。","speaker":"B","text":"We should have the relevant specialists identify those differences before treating the draft as a shared understanding of responsibility."},{"meaning":"這也牽涉在地化：直譯可能保留文字，卻掩蓋雙方在實務上的期待。","speaker":"A","text":"There's also a localisation issue: a literal translation may preserve the wording while obscuring what each party expects in practice."},{"meaning":"我們能否逐一討論幾個真實可能發生的情境，包括延誤、交付成果爭議，以及變更範疇的要求？","speaker":"B","text":"Could we work through a few realistic scenarios, including a delay, a disputed deliverable, and a request to change the scope?"},{"meaning":"那應該能提早揭露假設，前提是釐清結果會反映在規範合作關係的正式文件中。","speaker":"A","text":"That should expose assumptions early, provided the resulting clarifications are reflected in the documents that will govern the partnership."},{"meaning":"我會安排討論，並標出需要專業審查的部分，不會只靠調整措辭來處理法律差異。","speaker":"B","text":"I'll arrange that discussion and flag the points requiring specialist review, rather than trying to resolve legal differences through wording alone."}],"source":"manual","title":"跨國合作前釐清責任"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-film-cr: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-film-critique","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"我覺得這部電影的克制很有吸引力，尤其最後一幕沒有解決核心衝突，卻不讓人覺得殘缺。","speaker":"A","text":"I found the film's restraint compelling, especially the way the final scene leaves the central conflict unresolved without feeling incomplete."},{"meaning":"我也欣賞這一點，不過空房間的重複畫面，有時讓我覺得刻意多於能喚起感受。","speaker":"B","text":"I admired that too, although the repeated images of empty rooms occasionally struck me as more deliberate than evocative."},{"meaning":"也許正因為重複，最後鏡頭的細微變化才引起共鳴；我們因此留意到原本平凡的細節。","speaker":"A","text":"Perhaps their repetition is what makes the slight change in the last shot resonate; we're primed to notice an otherwise ordinary detail."},{"meaning":"這個解讀很有說服力，但我仍想知道，象徵安排是否留了足夠空間，讓角色顯得自然。","speaker":"B","text":"That's a persuasive reading, but I still wonder whether the symbolism leaves enough room for the characters to feel spontaneous."},{"meaning":"對我而言，那些尷尬的停頓提供了空間，因為它們抗拒了視覺結構似乎預告的整齊解釋。","speaker":"A","text":"For me, the awkward pauses provide that room, since they resist the neat explanations the visual structure seems to promise."},{"meaning":"我可能會帶著這個想法再看一次；我們的分歧似乎在於形式掌控與情感開放之間的平衡。","speaker":"B","text":"I might watch it again with that in mind; our disagreement seems to concern the balance between formal control and emotional openness."}],"source":"manual","title":"含蓄的電影是否更有力量"}
keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-plannin: {"createdAt":"2026-09-10T00:00:00.000Z","id":"keylingua-starter-en-dialogue-c1-planning-under-uncertainty","level":"C1","sentences":[{"meaning":"預測提供了有用的起點，但如果整個計畫都依中心估計值制定，我們就沒什麼調整空間。","speaker":"A","text":"The forecast offers a useful starting point, but building the entire plan around its central estimate would leave us little room to adapt."},{"meaning":"情境規劃能否幫我們找出在幾種合理未來下都適當的決策，而不是試圖預測單一結果？","speaker":"B","text":"Would scenario planning help us identify decisions that remain sensible across several plausible futures, rather than trying to predict one outcome?"},{"meaning":"可以，尤其在初期投入難以逆轉，而可用資訊很可能隨時間改善的情況下。","speaker":"A","text":"Yes, particularly where an early commitment would be difficult to reverse and the information available is likely to improve over time."},{"meaning":"不過，我們不應把保留選項等同於延後所有決策；拖延也有成本，也可能讓機會消失。","speaker":"B","text":"We shouldn't confuse keeping options open with postponing every decision, though; delay can carry costs and close off opportunities too."},{"meaning":"那我們區分現在就能採取的可逆步驟，以及應等待特定訊號或更多證據才做的承諾。","speaker":"A","text":"Then let's distinguish reversible steps we can take now from commitments that should depend on specific signals or additional evidence."},{"meaning":"那能讓計畫具體可行，也保留彈性，尤其是先約定何時以及基於什麼原因重新檢視。","speaker":"B","text":"That would make the plan actionable while preserving flexibility, especially if we agree in advance when and why we'll revisit it."}],"source":"manual","title":"不確定下保留調整空間"}
